text:
olivia: FYI FRA customs flagged AWB 5Z-123-999. infra says capacity will be impacted if we can't get partial release. vendor – can you confirm split/re-route options + any insurance/standby concessions?
zenith-ops: we can offer two paths: (1) immediate air split for up to 12 units (23 business days) + remainder by sea (~+7 days) with air surcharge $1,800/unit; or (2) full sea reroute (~+9 days) with 60% credit toward depot standby/handling. need PO consent for either.
maria: @olivia we have limited depot slots next week. we can provide temporary staging (leaseback) up to 14 days but will bill overtime for reconciliation. cost below.
maria: ```
leaseback 14d: $250/day flat for area + $120/unit handling
expedite handling (if air split): additional $90/unit
```
shipment-bot: Carrier alert: AWB 5Z-123-999 status = "Documentation review". ETAs shifted +36h.
chris: ops note: if shipment arrives without serial manifest we'll need to assign temp IDs and run a quick RMA reconciliation job (~2 person-days). this affects label policy and quarantine windows.
olivia: vendor, how firm is the 60% credit? can you instead absorb depot standby fees up to some cap if we take the split?
zenith-ops: we can absorb depot standby up to $5,000 if you commit to split booking now. credit is conditional on depot photos + invoice within 48h of delivery.
kevin: procurement can accept the $1.8k/unit for up to 12 units. beyond that we need stepped pricing — can you produce quotes for 12 / 24 / 36 split sizes?
zenith-ops: compiling numbers, will post shortly.
jess: infra heads up: staging policy requires serial reconciliation within 72h or units go into quarantine; staging buffer is limited next TueThu.
zenith-ops: quote posted: 12 air units = +$21,000 total (includes expedited handling & carrier markup). 24 split = +$38,000. 36 split = +$54,000. full export attached to vendor email.
olivia: tagging finance. @finance-bot can you approve $21k delta if vendor covers standby up to $5k?
finance-bot: routing for approval. need vendor T&Cs and credit confirmation.
maria: we can accept buffer for up to 18 units TueThu next week. 72h reconciliation SLA is doable but will require paid OT.
chris: RMA flow: if DOA at depot vendor agrees to pick within 5 business days and accept photo-first triage to avoid immediate reverse logistics? need explicit SLA to avoid duplicate depot charges.
zenith-ops: confirmed: RMA pickup SLA = 5 business days. vendor will accept photo triage via email for initial credits.
olivia: draft decision: split 12 air now, remainder by sea; vendor covers standby to $5k; we pay +$21k; staging to accept 18-unit buffer; RMA SLA 5bd. objections?
kevin: procurement signs off.
jess: we'll need a provisional manifest with temp IDs if serials missing.
chris: I'll write a short ops runbook for temp-ID assignment, RMA triage, and label handling.
zenith-ops: booking the air leg now. will post new AWBs for air and updated sea ETA in ~2 hours. sending invoice & depot photo checklist when AWBs are issued. :white_check_mark:
olivia: thanks everyone. please attach vendor confirmation of standby cap and RMA SLA to the PO amendment. :pray:
